title: SIP Calculator
description: Calculate the maturity value of your monthly SIP investments based on expected returns.

faqs.question: What is a SIP?
faqs.answer: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) lets you invest a fixed amount regularly, typically monthly, into a mutual fund, smoothing out market volatility over time.

faqs.question: Are SIP returns guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. This calculator projects an estimate based on an assumed annual return you enter — actual mutual fund returns fluctuate with the market and are not guaranteed.
